decisions.reason: The premium raisin stollen won the Deutsches Brotinstitut gold medal again, and the firm presents it as its flagship, so its value is largely confirmed and further commitment is justified rather than abandonment.

The dark malt rye bread survived the 2024 pruning of the other new breads and still has its own page, which signals acceptable results; keeping it costs little because it shares the existing bread production.

The marzipan stollen is a low-cost seasonal variant that uses the same production as the award-winning raisin stollen, has stayed on its own page for two years, and extends the firm's strongest line, so keeping the option open is cheap.
